Explore different countries, unique cultures, and uncover iconic rail routes. From snow-covered mountains to tropical jungles, this documentary playlist offers a front-row seat to some of the world's most scenic and culturally rich destinations. | DW Documentary

programs.title: Rick Steves' Europe
programs.description: Rick Steves’ Europe is public television’s most-watched, longest-running travel series. Written and hosted by best-selling guidebook author Rick Steves, each show takes viewers to Europe’s most interesting places, from great cities to off-the-beaten-path discoveries. Get travel info for these destinations at www.ricksteves.com

programs.title: Vintage Travelogues
programs.description: Public-domain travelogue and geography films, 1916-1949, from the Internet Archive (largely the Prelinger Archives): early city tours of London and Paris, Hawaii in the silent era, Merian C. Cooper and Ernest Schoedsack's 1925 ethnographic epic Grass, 1930s aerial and island journeys, and the U.S. Office of Inter-American Affairs' 1940s portraits of Latin American cities and countries.

programs.title: Kara and Nate
programs.description: Husband-and-wife travel filmmakers Kara and Nate Rice, who left Nashville in 2016 for a one-year trip that turned into more than a hundred countries: overland expeditions, long-distance train journeys, wildlife encounters and road trips, from the Mongol Rally across Central Asia to Patagonia, Oman, Iceland and the Australian Outback.

programs.title: Mark Wiens: Asia & the Middle East
programs.description: Food-and-travel host Mark Wiens eats his way through Asia and the Middle East -- street food, village cooking and markets from Bangkok, Penang and Old Delhi to Kabul, Damascus, Baghdad, Muscat and Baku. One of two regional World Explorer series built from the same official Mark Wiens channel import (see mark-wiens-africa-americas); every upload is approved in at most one of the two.

programs.description: Food-and-travel host Mark Wiens eats his way through Asia and the Middle East -- street food, village cooking and markets from Bangkok, Penang and Old Delhi to Kabul, Damascus, Baghdad, Muscat and Baku. One of two regional World Explorer series built from the same official Mark Wiens channel import (see mark-wiens-africa-americas); every upload is approved in at most one of the two.
